Definition: from G1093 and the base of G2041; a land-worker, i.e. farmer:--husbandman.
BiblicalUsage: geōrgós is the word for husbandman. I meet it 17 times across the Bible, and Matthew is a good place to see it plainly. It says what it says, and I take it at face value.
TheologicalSignificance: What geōrgós tells me is that the earth is the Lord’s, and every part of it belongs to Him. What I take from it is this — the plain sense is the safe sense.
RelatedEvents: The Parable of the Wicked Tenants; The Vine and the Branches
